svg.title: Sequence part 2 (Stage 3) - turns 14-18: READY -> SERVED -> eating -> PAID, then the result check

g.text: Sequence part 2 (Stage 3) - turns 14-18: READY -> SERVED -> eating -> PAID, then the result check
turn 14: the Waiter serves #4 instead (the choice delayed from turn 13)
polymorphic hook: a Regular has no
reaction; a Critic checks for cold food
[still PREPARING, or READY only this turn]
Turn 18: Cashier (automatic, at most one per turn, oldest first)
#5 pays $19.44 on the last turn, so 5 customers pay instead of 4 and revenue is $87.84 instead of $68.40.
Had the Waiter served #4 first on turn 13, #5's combo would only be READY on turn 16, served on 17, and #5 could not pay within 18 turns.
Happy Hour also cut #5's bill from $24.30 to $19.44 and lifted #4 from 76 to 98 satisfaction, raising the average.
